title: Zero Username price when it is minted with `mintUsername()`
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  The `AccountSystem` contract allows users to mint new accounts by paying Ether through the `mintWithEth` function. This function correctly enforces the payment requirement by checking the mint price stored in the` ETH_MINT_PRICE_CID` column of the `AccountSystem` table. Manager can set this price using the `setMintPrice` function in the AccountSystem contract.
